limitations.wami: Input conversion/packing subtracted from primary time, retained in raw time; output unpack, cache synchronization, DMA and polling retained.
limitations.nightvision: Input quantization subtracted from primary time, retained in raw time; DMA packing, buffer clearing, output unpack and cache synchronization retained.
limitations.other_applications: Full elapsed time, including data preparation.
limitations.verification: All supplied board records report reference verification unchecked. Fixed-point output signatures do not establish original-float equivalence.

area_scope: Synthesis-derived cell area normalized to a common 45nm-equivalent basis, including standard cells and SRAM macros once; only 1000KiB application RAM excluded. Not actual 45nm synthesis or post-route die area.
board_speedup_figure_series: one reported-speedup series plus geometric mean
